newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy basis mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy basis mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean basis offers were mostly steady on Friday amid subdued activity, dealers said.
On the export front, private exporters reported the sale of 100,000 tonnes of U.S. corn to unknown buyers for delivery during the 1996/97 marketing year, U.S. Agriculture Department said.

Jordan bought about 100,000 tonnes U.S. HRW wheat, several U.S. exporters said. South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd bought a combined 23,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat on Friday from Japanese trading house Mitsubishi Corp.
In addition, four major export firms swapped a total of about 600,000 tonnes of corn from Argentine to U.S. origin to supply buyers mainly in South Korea, Argentine traders said.
